An attacker positioned on the network between an Airflow worker and S3 could intercept that traffic, read the signed requests and alter the listed object…

The vulnerability is present for all sites, even if they do not enable the dynamic…

item.title: NLTK: Unbounded CPU consumption in SteppingRecursiveDescentParser.parse() with ambiguous or self-embedding grammars
item.description: Summary nltk.parse.recursivedescent.SteppingRecursiveDescentParser.parse() performs an unbounded top-down search over ambiguous or self-embedding context-free grammars with no wall-clock or step limit. An actor who can influence the grammar and supply a short input to a caller that uses this parser can force a single parse() call to pin a CPU core indefinitely, producing a denial of service. The related base class…

item.title: Tornado: Open redirect via triple-slash redirect paths
item.description: Summary Due to differences in the way browsers and Python's urllib parse urls, browsers treat a string starting with three or more slashes as a protocol-level redirect, while urllib does not. This means that the 6.6.0 fix for the RedirectHandler open redirect (CVE-2026-116578, commit cc75ab0e) is incomplete. Tornado 6.6.1 improves the open-redirect detection to handle this case correctly, as well as fixing a…
